title: Password field
description: A lock that answers focus, an eye that follows the toggle, and a hint that arrives word by word.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: The field and the lock
fragments.note: The lock watches data-focused on the field it sits in, through target.

fragments.title: The reveal toggle and the eye
fragments.note: aria-pressed on the button. state picks the morph.

fragments.title: The error message and its icon
fragments.note: data-raised counts how many times the message has been shown.

fragments.title: Show the message
fragments.note: Slides in; the words use the same wave the accordion uses.

fragments.title: Hide the message
fragments.note: A drop and a fade, then hidden. Safe to call on every keystroke.
